faq.q: Is this done by AI or by a person?
faq.a: The work is AI-assisted. Drafts, summaries and clean-ups are produced with AI tools. The review process is described on the How it works page, and you can ask us about it in your enquiry.
We do not publish prices yet. Every service is quoted individually: use the Request a quote page and describe what you need.

faq.q: Can I pay on this website?
faq.a: No. This site only collects enquiries. There is no checkout and no payment form.

faq.q: What happens to my business information?
faq.a: Please do not send passwords, payment card numbers or other highly sensitive data in an enquiry. See the Privacy page for what this website does and does not collect.

faq.q: Do you guarantee results or turnaround times?
faq.a: No. We do not make guarantees about outcomes or timing on this site. Any timing is agreed in writing for your specific request.

faq.q: Who is behind AI Virtual Assistant Co?
faq.a: The business is run by Kevin Britz. See the About page.
